# Data {#sec-data}

The examples read local Parquet files through `era_pl.load_parquet()`.
The `DATA_DIR` setting points to the data root, and each table lives at
`DATA_DIR/schema/table.parquet`. See the
[repository's setup instructions](https://github.com/iangow/asset_pricing_polars#render)
to render the book with your own copies. The repository does not include
the licensed WRDS data.

## WRDS tables {#data-vintages}

The table lists the inputs used in this build. The source update date comes
from the metadata embedded in each Parquet file, read with
[db2pq](https://iangow.github.io/db2pq/). It is not the sample end date
or the date the file was downloaded.

```{python}
#| echo: false

import re

from db2pq import pq_last_modified
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

tables = [
    ("crsp", "msf_v2", "CRSP CIZ",
     "Monthly returns and market equity for the sorts and regressions."),
    ("crsp", "dsf_v2", "CRSP CIZ",
     "Daily returns and dollar volume for Amihud illiquidity."),
    ("ff", "factors_monthly", "Fama–French",
     "Monthly factors and the risk-free rate for alphas and market checks."),
    ("ff", "factors_daily", "Fama–French",
     "Daily market excess returns for Chapter 7 crash checks."),
    ("crsp", "msf", "CRSP legacy (SIZ)",
     "Legacy prices, shares outstanding, and monthly returns."),
    ("crsp", "msenames", "CRSP legacy (SIZ)",
     "Historical share codes, exchanges, and industries."),
    ("crsp", "msedelist", "CRSP legacy (SIZ)",
     "Delisting returns and codes for the Chapter 7 return tables."),
    ("crsp", "msi", "CRSP legacy (SIZ)",
     "CRSP value-weighted index for the market factor comparison."),
]

rows = [
    "| WRDS table | Dataset | Used for | Source updated |",
    "|:---|:---|:---|:---|",
]
for schema, name, dataset, purpose in tables:
    metadata = pq_last_modified(name, schema) or ""
    match = re.search(r"Updated (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", metadata)
    updated = match[1] if match else "Not recorded"
    rows.append(f"| `{schema}.{name}` | {dataset} | {purpose} | {updated} |")

display(Markdown("\n".join(rows)))
```

Most examples use CRSP's newer CIZ files. The [Chapter 7 replication](crsp-replication.qmd) and
[Table 9.1 replication](size-replication.qmd) instead use legacy CRSP (SIZ), the format available when Bali, Engle, and
Murray wrote the book. The local legacy exports are newer than their
original snapshot. CIZ is not a drop-in substitute for legacy monthly
returns: the two formats differ, for example, in the timing of dividend
reinvestment. See [CRSP's comparison of the formats](https://www.crsp.org/crsp_pdf/crsp-us-stock-indexes-databases-siz-to-ciz-executive-summary/).

## Other input

Both BEM replication chapters also use the
[BLS all-items CPI for urban consumers, not seasonally adjusted](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCNS),
from FRED, to express market capitalizations in December 2012 dollars.
This file does not come from WRDS.
